mcpExplore.title: MCP
mcpExplore.intro: Chat with an AI assistant that explores the catalog and runs SQL for you through the governed MCP tools — the same tools external agents use.
mcpExplore.emptyState: Ask about your data — e.g. "which tables have customer email?", "top 10 orders by amount", or "what does the orders table look like?"
mcpExplore.inputPlaceholder: Ask about your catalog or data…
mcpExplore.clearTooltip: Clear the draft question without sending it. The conversation above is kept.
mcpExplore.roleNoteTooltip: Every catalog lookup and query the assistant runs is executed as this role, so it sees exactly the tables, columns, and rows that role is granted.
mcpExplore.toolDoneTooltip: {{name}} finished. Its result was handed back to the assistant.
mcpExplore.toolErrorTooltip: {{name}} failed. The assistant received the error and may retry with different arguments.
mcpExplore.roleNoteHelpTitle: The role this session runs as
